bool VoicerBaseUGenInternal::stealNote ( const int  midiChannel,
const int  midiNote,
const bool  forcedSteal = false,
const bool  stealAll = true 
) throw ()

Steal one or more notes with a particular MIDI note and/or MIDI channel.

Parameters:
midiChannel The MIDI channel on which the MIDI note should be to be stolen.
midiNote The MIDI note number that should be stolen.
forcedSteal If true this will stop the note immediately, if false the voice will be allowed to fade out quickly.
stealAll If true all notes of this note number and channel will be stolen, if false only the first to be found will be stolen.
Returns:
True if a voice was actually stolen or false if no matching voice was found (nothing was stolen).
See also:
UGen::steal()
